region: Not stated in source (private banda-style accommodation)
sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/OL GABOLI/Ol Gaboli Rate Card 2026.pdf
notes: ANOMALY: The rate card PDF contains TWO different non-resident rate tables that appear to overlap in coverage but disagree in figures and season boundaries: a 'LAUNCH RATES, for stays until 1st April 2026' table (High Season Jan-Mar/Jun-Oct/19Dec+, Adult Rack $210/$158) and a '2025/26 NON-RESIDENT RATES Valid at December 2025' table (High Season Jun-18Dec, Low Season Apr-May, Adult Rack $250/$210). Both are quoted below verbatim, unreconciled - which one actually applies for a given 2026 date needs to be confirmed directly with Ol Gaboli before quoting.
NETT rate confirmed arithmetically as approximately Rack x 0.80 (20% discount) across both tables (e.g. Launch High Adult: 168 = 210 x 0.8; 2025/26 High Adult: 200 = 250 x 0.8).
Payments page states 'All payments will be subject to VAT at 16% and Tourism Levy at 2%' with no indication whether the rate card figures already include these - flagged as unclear.
Single occupancy = applicable PPN rate + 60% of same rate (i.e. 1.6x the sharing rate), consistent across all three rate tables.

childPolicy.raw: Under 5s stay free when sharing with parents. 5-12 charged at the Child rate shown.

singleOccupancy.raw: Applicable PPN rate + 60% of same rate

minStay: 5 nights over Christmas and New Year
includes: Morning and evening guided walks and guided self-drive safaris (guest must bring/hire a vehicle)
excludes: All statutory increases beyond their control
Conservancy fees are billed separately per calendar day (see above) despite 'community fees' being included

policies.balancePayment: Due no later than 60 days prior to arrival, NETT of all bank charges
policies.cancellation: >120 days: 20% deposit refunded in full; 60-120 days: 20% deposit forfeited; 30-60 days: 50% of total paid forfeited; <30 days: 100% forfeited. No refunds for no-show, flight cancellation, or early departure.
policies.privateVehicleWithGuide: Available for exclusive use at additional cost per day - contact for current rates
policies.tippingGuidance: Recommended US$15 per person per night
